papers.title: Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Object Tracking
papers.authors: Kyujin Shim; Kangwook Ko; Yujin Yang; Changick Kim
papers.tags: tracking, object detection, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种名为TrackTrack的新型在线多目标跟踪器，通过轨迹视角关联（TPA）和轨迹感知初始化（TAI）两种策略，从每个轨迹的局部视角出发进行数据关联并充分利用所有检测结果（包括低置信度和NMS丢弃的高置信度检测结果），在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack数据集上取得了优于现有最…

papers.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.authors: Junchao Huang, Guian Fang, Shengju Qian, Xianghao Kong, Zhuoran Zhao, Wei Huang, Yihua Du, Zixin Zhang, Justin Cui, Yuchao Gu, Yukang Chen, Xinting Hu, Tianyu He, Shaoshuai Shi, Zhuotao Tian, Xin Wang, Mike Zheng Shou, Li Jiang
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, autonomous driving, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: CUHK-SZ, SLAI, NUS, CUHK, HKUST, HKUST-GZ, NVIDIA, UCLA, MSRA
papers.intro: SolarWM提出了一个完全开放的交互式视频世界模型基础框架，通过可重构的多源数据引擎和骨干原生适配框架，在统一的三阶段训练协议下训练了四个5B-33B规模的模型，仅基于5秒序列训练即可实现分钟到小时级别的开放时程交互式推演。

papers.title: Thinking in Pictures: A Systematic Benchmark for Reasoning-driven Image Generation
papers.authors: Yutong Liu, Nan Huang, Xu Cao, James M. Rehg
papers.tags: image generation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; New York University
papers.intro: 本文提出了RIG-BENCH——首个系统性地评估推理驱动图像生成能力的综合基准，包含2000个精心策划的样本，覆盖概念推理、变换推理、模式与结构推理、场景推理四大任务族，揭示了当前最先进生成模型在逻辑视觉推理方面的显著"推理-生成鸿沟"。

papers.title: PlantC2USeg: Cross-Scale Consistent Pre-Training for Few-Shot Unified Plant Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.authors: Yu Tian, Xintong Jiang, Jan Franklin Adamowski, Shiv O. Prasher, Shangpeng Sun
papers.tags: point cloud, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: McGill University
papers.intro: PlantC2USeg提出了一种结合跨尺度一致性学习和信息受限解码策略的深度迁移学习框架，通过自监督预训练实现少样本条件下跨物种、跨传感器的统一植物点云语义与实例分割。

papers.title: MuyBridge: Mobile Human Center-of-Mass Estimation from Monocular Video via Sparse Fusion
papers.authors: Aidan Bradshaw, Marco Giordano, David Rode, Andreas Habersack, Elif Basokur, Annika Kruse, Markus Tilp, Michele Magno, Peter Wolf, Luca Benini, Christoph Leitner
papers.tags: pose estimation, edge deployment, depth estimation, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: ETH Zurich, University of Graz, University of Bologna
papers.intro: MuyBridge是一个端侧系统，通过将紧凑的2D姿态网络与蒸馏的单步单目深度网络相结合，利用解剖学和物理学先验进行解析度量融合，在无需3D或任务特定监督的情况下，从单部手机摄像头视频流中实时估计运动员的分段质心轨迹。

papers.title: RoGe: Novel View Synthesis via End-to-End Implicit Reconstruction and Generation
papers.authors: Xiaolei Lang, Ze Kang, Zehao Huang, Naiyan Wang
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, 3D reconstruction, NeRF
papers.affiliations: Xiaomi EV（小米汽车）；Northeastern University（东北大学）
papers.intro: RoGe提出了一种端到端的重建与生成统一框架，通过将前馈重建网络产生的隐式场景表示以射线查询方式提取几何特征，直接注入视频扩散模型作为条件，消除了显式3D中间表示这一"有损桥梁"，使生成目标能够直接塑造自身的几何条件。

papers.title: GDB-Reward: From Evaluation Metrics to Training Rewards for Graphic Design
papers.authors: Adrienne Deganutti, Purvanshi Mehta, Simon Hadfield, Andrew Gilbert
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, OCR, YOLO
papers.affiliations: Lica World, University of Surrey
papers.intro: 本文提出GDB-Reward框架，将异构的图形设计评估指标系统地转化为统一的强化学习奖励，通过GRPO优化轻量级LoRA适配器来学习提示策略，在保持图像生成器完全冻结的情况下显著提升设计规范遵循度。

papers.title: Multi-Tool Image Editing Attribution in Facial Forgery
papers.authors: Sheng Liu, Qiang Sheng, Danding Wang, Yu Li, Chenming Zhou, Juan Cao
papers.tags: image classification, image generation, image retrieval
papers.affiliations: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文首次提出多工具图像编辑归因任务（MIEA），构建了包含50万+编辑人脸图像的大规模数据集MultiEdit，并设计了DPEC方法，通过双域分块特征增强和基于错误的课程学习策略，从空间和频域捕获可区分、局部感知的编辑工具痕迹，实现对最多五步编辑图像中所有参与工具的准确识别。

papers.title: RVSD: Retrieval Vision Sparse Decoding for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Canjie Liu, Jiawen Kang, Jinbo Wen, Zishao Zhong
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: 广东工业大学自动化学院、香港城市大学计算机科学系、广州中医药大学第二附属医院
papers.intro: RVSD提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的解码框架，首次将token稀疏化与语义空间视觉检索（SSVR）统一在单次解码过程中，通过将剪除的视觉token转化为可检索的记忆库并在需要时按需恢复视觉证据，从而在保持推理效率的同时有效缓解视觉幻觉。

papers.title: MV-dVRK: A Multi-Viewpoint Benchmark for Spatial Surgical Perception
papers.authors: Guido Caccianiga, Sergey Prokudin, Yutong Chen, Bernard Javot, Rachael L'Orsa, Omer Burak Aladağ, Yarden Sharon, Jens Rolinger, Ivan Capobianco, Anton Deguet, Siyu Tang, Katherine J. Kuchenbecker
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, medical image, autonomous driving, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, ETH Zürich, Erbe Group, Tübingen University Hospital, Johns Hopkins University
papers.intro: 本文提出了MV-dVRK——首个结合多个曝光同步立体视角、精确表面几何和相机位姿的离体手术多视角基准数据集，并系统比较了单目、立体、多立体和多视角3D重建方法在稀疏视角下的性能。

papers.title: Generating Medical Image Counterfactuals using Causal Explanations
papers.authors: David A. Kelly, Tom Yaacov, Nathan Blake, Sander Beckers, Hana Chockler
papers.tags: medical image, image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: King's College London（David A. Kelly, Tom Yaacov, Nathan Blake, Hana Chockler）；University College London（Sander Beckers）
papers.intro: 该论文提出了一种无需生成模型的医学图像反事实生成框架，通过直接从分类器自身的因果解释中提取并迁移因果像素证据，以确定性、可控制的方式生成能够翻转分类器预测的最小反事实图像，从而提供对分类器决策边界的直接、透明审计。

papers.title: SpatialGuard: Harness-Guided Verifiable Spatial Reasoning for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Ziyun Qian, Zizhi Chen, Yizhou Liu, Mingyang Sun, Dingkang Yang, Lihua Zhang
papers.tags: image generation, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: College of Intelligent Robotics and Advanced Manufacturing, Fudan University; Fysics Intelligence Technologies Co., Ltd. (Fysics AI)
papers.intro: SpatialGuard提出了一种基于布局引导的可验证空间推理框架，通过引入"布局约束带"（Layout Harness）机制，将复杂3D空间文本到图像生成从隐式提示跟随转变为可验证的规划-实现-验证-修复闭环过程。

papers.title: H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control
papers.authors: Danze Chen, Zeqing Wang, Ziyue Lin, Xingyi Yang, Yeying Jin
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Tencent, National University of Singapore, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: H3-World提出了一种高效框架，通过将角色和相机动作表示为组合式文本指令，并引入时间注意力路由机制，仅用0.199%的可训练参数将33B参数的MiniMax-H3视频生成器转化为精确、时间可控的交互式世界模型。

papers.title: Revisiting Cross-View Completion: Self-Supervised Pre-Training via Reconstruction Error Comparison
papers.authors: Thibaut Loiseau, Guillaume Bourmaud, Vincent Lepetit
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, pose estimation
papers.affiliations: LIGM, Ecole Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées, IP Paris, Univ Gustave Eiffel, CNRS, France; Univ. Bordeaux, CNRS, Bordeaux INP, IMS, UMR 5218, France
papers.intro: 本文提出Gekko，一种通过预测跨视角补全误差与掩码自编码误差之间的相对改进量来提供全掩码区域双目训练信号的自监督预训练方法，在零样本对应估计、相对位姿估计和点图回归等任务上一致优于CroCo。

papers.title: DualDiff3D: Dual Structure-Appearance Diffusion Priors for Reliability-Enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Qian Wang, Yu Wang, Weiqi Li, Xinhua Cheng, Xiandong Meng, Ronggang Wang, Jian Zhang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: School of Electronic and Computer Engineering, Peking University, Shenzhen, China; Pengcheng Laboratory, Shenzhen, China; Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Ultra High Definition Immersive Media Technology, Shenzhen, China
papers.intro: 本文提出DualDiff3D，通过双分支扩散先验（结构分支与外观分支）配合结构-外观注意力（SAA）模块解耦处理结构和外观信息，并集成可靠性增强的渲染-精化-优化（RRO）循环，实现对稀疏视角下3DGS重建质量的显著提升。

papers.title: TempCloze: Can Video-LLMs Identify the Missing Middle?
papers.authors: Wenqi Pei, Henry Hengyuan Zhao, Yilai Liu, Jiahao Meng, Han Chen, Ziyu Wang, Hongyang Du
papers.tags: video segmentation, video generation, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore, Peking University
papers.intro: TempCloze是一个视频完形填空基准，通过让模型从四个候选中识别给定开头和结尾之间的真实缺失中间段，从语义、对齐和进展三个维度评估Video-LLMs的视觉时间推理能力，并揭示了对齐（Alignment）是当前模型的主要瓶颈。

papers.title: CameraEditor: Camera-Controlled Image Editing via Video-Prior Sequential Modeling
papers.authors: Xin Shen, Chengyou Jia, Keshuo Xing, Zifeng Zhu, Changliang Xia, Bowen Ping, Zhuohang Dang, Hangwei Qian, Minnan Luo
papers.tags: image generation, video generation, diffusion model, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: 西安交通大学（Xi'an Jiaotong University）、新加坡科技研究局（A*STAR）
papers.intro: CameraEditor提出了一种将相机控制图像编辑从空间问题重构为时间序列预测任务的框架，通过利用视频扩散模型的时间一致性、显式几何感知模块和动态参考路由机制，实现了精确的相机参数化编辑，并配套构建了训练数据集和评估基准CamEditor-Bench。

papers.title: Gaussian Core LoRA: Distribution-Aware Dynamic Adaptation for Broad Concept Erasure
papers.authors: Qinghui Gong, Xunlei Chen, Yu-Xuan Zhang, Hua Meng, Zhengchun Zhou
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University（Qinghui Gong, Yu-Xuan Zhang, Hua Meng, Zhengchun Zhou）；University of Electronic Science and Technology of China（Xunlei Chen）
papers.intro: 本文提出Gaussian Core LoRA，一种分布感知的动态低秩适配框架，通过在高斯混合模型中建模目标概念的潜在语义原型，并根据输入提示的分布位置动态重构共享LoRA秩空间，实现对广泛概念的原型自适应擦除。

papers.title: Pix2Rep-v2: Data-Efficient Representation Learning for Dense Medical Imaging Applications
papers.authors: S. Sifaoui, E. Angelini, S. Toupin, T. Pezel, L. Le Folgoc
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: LTCI, Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, Palaiseau, France; MIRACL.ai Laboratory, Hôpital Universitaire Lariboisière (AP-HP), Paris, France; Université Paris Cité, Inserm MASCOT, Paris, France
papers.intro: Pix2Rep-v2提出了一种基于冗余消除目标和等变性原则的密集自监督学习框架，通过高效的像素级表示学习和多尺度补丁采样策略，在少样本医学影像分割任务中显著超越全监督基线，并支持无需微调的原位上下文分割和视频传播。

papers.title: Semantic-Guided Multimodal Preprocessing for Vision Transformer-Based Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Grading
papers.authors: Fatemeh Javadian, Zhu Chen, Zahra Aminparast, Johannes Stegmaier
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, vision transformer, semantic segmentation
papers.affiliations: RWTH Aachen University, Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf, Kermanshah University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种语义引导的多模态预处理方法，通过将预训练细胞核分类模型的分类图与RGB组织病理图像融合，使Vision Transformer能够同时利用细粒度细胞核分级信息和粗粒度组织上下文进行CCRCC分级，在保持RGB纹理特征的同时显著提升分级性能。
